Canvas
Canvas is a versatile Learning Management System (LMS) designed to enhance online education. It offers robust course management, communication tools, a Gradebook, mobile accessibility. Canvas supports collaborative learning, provides detailed analytics, ensures security and privacy, and offers extensive support and training resources, making it a popular choice for K-12 schools, higher education, and corporate training programs.
Anthology (Blackboard)
Anthology, formerly Blackboard, is an education tech suite that improves learning and administration in schools. It includes a strong LMS for course management, collaboration tools, detailed analytics, mobile access, and extensive support. It also offers a Student Information System (SIS) for student data management and tools for community engagement and alumni relations, covering the entire student lifecycle from recruitment to alumni.
SkillJar
Skilljar is a cloud-based learning management system (LMS) designed for businesses to create, manage, and deliver customer education and training programs. It supports multimedia course creation, branded learning portals, CRM and analytics integrations, detailed reporting, certification programs, and user management. Skilljar helps organizations onboard, train, and certify customers, partners, and employees, driving product adoption, reducing support costs, and improving customer retention.
D2L
D2L, formerly Desire2Learn, offers Brightspace, a cloud-based learning management system. Brightspace features personalized learning, engagement tools, robust assessment and analytics, and mobile accessibility. It integrates with other educational tools, serving K-12 schools, higher education, and corporate training programs for effective online learning.
Intellum
Intellum offers an enterprise learning and customer education platform for tailored training, employee onboarding, and product education. It features customizable learning experiences, scalability, gamification, social learning, comprehensive analytics, and integration with CRM, HRIS, and marketing automation systems.
Thought Industries
Thought Industries offers a robust learning management platform for businesses, featuring customizable learning paths, interactive tools, detailed analytics, and e-commerce integration. It enhances customer success, product knowledge, and business growth through effective and scalable training programs.
Docebo
Docebo is a cloud-based LMS specializing in corporate training and employee development. It offers tools for creating, managing, and delivering diverse learning content, supports social learning and mobile access, and provides robust analytics. With seamless integration options, Docebo helps organizations enhance workforce skills and performance efficiently.
Open edX
Open edX is an open-source platform for delivering interactive and scalable online courses. It offers robust course authoring tools, supports small classes and MOOCs, and includes engagement features like discussion forums and peer assessments. With comprehensive analytics and reporting, it tracks learner progress and performance. Its open-source nature allows extensive customization and integration, making it ideal for educational institutions, businesses, and nonprofits worldwide.
EdX
edX, is a nonprofit online platform offering high-quality courses from top institutions. It provides flexible learning options, certifications, and interactive features like video lectures and quizzes. edX also offers specialized programs such as MicroMasters and Professional Certificates for career advancement, serving millions of learners worldwide.
Absorb
Absorb LMS is a cloud-based platform designed for corporate training and development. It allows organizations to manage and deliver online courses, certifications, and training materials efficiently. With robust reporting, mobile learning support, and seamless integration capabilities, Absorb LMS enhances employee learning experiences and optimizes organizational training processes.
Cornerstone Ondemand
Cornerstone OnDemand is a leading talent management platform that helps organizations manage the entire employee lifecycle, from recruitment to performance management and learning. With its comprehensive suite of tools, Cornerstone OnDemand enables companies to attract, develop, and retain top talent.
Workday
Workday's ATS and talent management system offers seamless integration with HR processes, simplifying complex hiring workflows. Its advanced AI features streamline candidate sourcing, automate resume screening, and provide predictive analytics to quickly identify top talent. For talent management, Workday excels in personalized development plans, real-time performance feedback, and dynamic career pathing, ensuring employees are engaged and aligned with business goals.
SuccessFactors
SuccessFactors, part of SAP, offers a cloud-based HCM suite that streamlines HR functions like talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, and learning. With advanced analytics and intuitive interfaces, it helps organizations make data-driven decisions, boost employee engagement, and align individual goals with business strategies. Its scalability and customization make it ideal for businesses of all sizes to attract, develop, and retain top talent.
Greenhouse
Greenhouse is a top applicant tracking system (ATS) that streamlines job posting, candidate management, and interview scheduling. It provides data-driven insights and customizable workflows, enhancing efficiency and collaboration among hiring teams. With its user-friendly interface and integration capabilities, Greenhouse helps companies attract and hire top talent effectively.
Infinite BrassRing
Infinite BrassRing is a cutting-edge talent management solution that streamlines recruitment with AI-driven candidate sourcing, screening, and selection. It offers real-time analytics, customizable workflows, and seamless integration with HR systems, enabling efficient and accurate hiring. Its user-friendly interface and robust reporting tools help organizations make data-driven decisions, enhancing the quality and speed of the recruitment process.
SmartRecruiters
SmartRecruiters is an innovative recruitment platform that streamlines hiring with advanced AI technology. It offers tools for sourcing, screening, and selecting top talent efficiently, including automated resume parsing, intelligent candidate matching, and interview scheduling, enhancing productivity and the recruitment experience.
Taleo
Taleo is a comprehensive talent management software suite designed to streamline the recruitment and onboarding processes. It offers robust features for job posting, candidate sourcing, application tracking, and performance management. With its user-friendly interface and powerful analytics, Taleo helps organizations efficiently manage the entire talent acquisition lifecycle, from attracting top talent to onboarding and developing employees
iCIMS
iCIMS is a leading talent acquisition platform designed to streamline the hiring process for businesses of all sizes. It offers robust tools for job posting, candidate sourcing, applicant tracking, and onboarding, providing a comprehensive solution for managing the entire recruitment lifecycle. With user-friendly features and powerful analytics, iCIMS helps organizations attract, engage, and hire top talent efficiently.
LinkedIn Talent Hub
LinkedIn Talent Hub is a comprehensive applicant tracking system (ATS) designed to streamline the hiring process by leveraging LinkedIn's vast network and advanced analytics. It allows recruiters to manage job postings, track candidate applications, and collaborate with team members all within one platform. With its powerful search and filtering capabilities, Talent Hub helps identify and engage top talent quickly.
PeopleStrong
PeopleStrong is an advanced HR technology platform that streamlines talent acquisition, employee engagement, payroll, and performance management. With user-friendly features and powerful analytics, it enables organizations to manage their workforce efficiently and make data-driven decisions. Its integration capabilities and mobile accessibility ensure a seamless HR experience for modern businesses.
ZipRecruiter
ZipRecruiter is a top online employment marketplace that connects employers with job seekers quickly and efficiently. Using advanced matching technology, it distributes job postings to over 100 job boards and delivers qualified candidates to employers. Its user-friendly interface and powerful tools streamline the hiring process, making it easier for companies to find the right talent.
Eightfold.ai
is an advanced talent intelligence platform designed to enhance the entire talent lifecycle using AI and machine learning. It offers solutions for talent acquisition, management, and retention by leveraging deep-learning algorithms to match candidates with the right roles, identify skill gaps, and provide personalized career development recommendations. With its comprehensive and intuitive interface,
helps organizations make data-driven decisions, optimize workforce planning, and foster a more engaged and skilled workforce
Beamery
Beamery is a leading talent lifecycle management platform designed to help organizations attract, engage, and retain top talent. It offers robust tools for candidate relationship management, recruitment marketing, and talent analytics, providing a comprehensive solution for modern HR needs. By leveraging AI and automation, Beamery enables companies to build stronger talent pipelines, enhance candidate experiences, and make data-driven hiring decisions.
Avature
Avature is a versatile enterprise SaaS platform for talent acquisition and management. It offers customizable tools for recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee engagement. With a user-friendly interface and powerful analytics, Avature streamlines HR processes, enhances candidate and employee experiences, and supports data-driven decisions. Its robust integration capabilities ensure seamless connections with existing HR systems.
Zwayam
Zwayam is a comprehensive recruitment automation platform designed to streamline the hiring process for organizations of all sizes. It offers features such as job posting, candidate sourcing, applicant tracking, and onboarding, all within a user-friendly interface. By leveraging AI and automation, Zwayam helps recruiters efficiently manage the entire talent acquisition lifecycle, from attracting top talent to making data-driven hiring decisions.
Turbohire
TurboHire is a recruitment automation platform that optimizes hiring using AI and machine learning. It automates tasks like candidate sourcing, resume parsing, and interview scheduling. With its intuitive interface and powerful analytics, TurboHire provides actionable insights for data-driven hiring decisions, making the recruitment process faster and more efficient.
Ripplehire
RippleHire is an innovative employee referral platform that simplifies the recruitment process by leveraging the power of employee networks. It automates referral tracking, streamlines the hiring workflow, and boosts engagement through gamification. With its user-friendly interface and robust analytics, RippleHire helps organizations tap into high-quality talent pools, reduce hiring time, and improve overall recruitment efficiency. Its seamless integration with existing HR systems ensures a smooth and effective referral program, driving better hiring outcomes.
Inspera
Inspera is a leading digital assessment platform that simplifies online exams for educational and certification bodies. With secure proctoring, advanced analytics, and seamless integration, it ensures reliable, efficient, and fair assessments, enhancing academic integrity and reducing administrative effort, while providing a superior testing experience.
RM Assessments
RM Assessments provides secure, scalable digital assessment solutions that streamline exam processes for educational institutions and certification bodies. Their platform enhances exam integrity, simplifies administration, and delivers a seamless, equitable testing experience, backed by advanced analytics and reporting tools.
IKM Techcheck
IKM TechCheck is a comprehensive skills assessment platform designed to evaluate technical proficiency across various industries. It offers customizable tests, real-time analytics, and detailed reporting to help organizations identify and develop talent effectively. With its robust features, including adaptive testing and secure exam environments, IKM TechCheck ensures accurate, reliable, and fair assessments, making it an essential tool for talent acquisition and development.
Psymetrics
Psymetrics is a leading provider of psychological and behavioral assessments designed to help organizations evaluate and develop their workforce. By offering a wide range of scientifically validated tests, Psymetrics enables employers to gain insights into candidates' cognitive abilities, personality traits, and job-related skills. This data-driven approach supports informed decision-making, enhancing hiring processes, employee development, and overall organizational performance.
HackerEarth
HackerEarth is a leading platform for technical recruitment and skill assessment, offering a comprehensive suite of tools for coding challenges, hackathons, and technical interviews. It enables organizations to effectively evaluate and hire top tech talent by providing a vast library of coding problems, real-time coding environments, and advanced analytics. With its focus on improving the hiring process and enhancing developer skills, HackerEarth is an essential resource for companies seeking to build strong, innovative tech teams.
Speaknow
Speaknow is an innovative communication platform designed to enhance collaboration and engagement through real-time voice and video interactions. It offers a seamless and intuitive interface for virtual meetings, webinars, and online discussions, supporting features like screen sharing, recording, and interactive polls. With robust security measures and scalable solutions, Speaknow caters to businesses, educational institutions, and organizations looking to improve remote communication and foster dynamic, productive interactions.
Skillevant
Skillevant is an advanced skill assessment platform designed to help organizations evaluate and develop their workforce effectively. It offers a wide range of customizable tests and real-time analytics to measure various competencies and skills. With features like AI-driven proctoring, detailed reporting, and seamless integrations, Skillevant ensures accurate, fair, and efficient assessments, making it an essential tool for talent acquisition and employee development.
Imocha
iMocha is a leading skill assessment platform designed to help organizations evaluate and enhance their workforce effectively. It offers a vast library of customizable assessments across various domains, powered by AI-driven analytics and reporting. With features like advanced proctoring, real-time feedback, and seamless integrations, iMocha ensures accurate, fair, and efficient evaluations, making it an invaluable tool for talent acquisition, development, and management.
Surpass
Surpass is a cutting-edge assessment platform designed to streamline the creation, delivery, and management of exams for educational institutions and certification bodies. It offers a range of features including customizable question types, secure test environments, and detailed analytics. With its user-friendly interface and robust proctoring capabilities, Surpass ensures accurate, fair, and efficient assessments, making it an essential tool for modern exam administration.
Caveon
specializes in test security solutions, using advanced technologies such as data forensics and monitoring to safeguard high-stakes exams. They help organizations prevent fraud and ensure the integrity of their assessments. Trusted by educational institutions and certification bodies alike, Caveon is known for maintaining the credibility and fairness of testing processes.
Zoom
Zoom is a leading video conferencing platform that facilitates virtual meetings, webinars, and online collaborations with ease. Renowned for its high-quality video and audio, Zoom offers a range of features including screen sharing, breakout rooms, and real-time messaging. Its user-friendly interface and robust security measures make it an ideal choice for businesses, educational institutions, and individuals looking to connect remotely. Zoom's versatile integration capabilities further enhance productivity, making it a cornerstone for modern communication.
Outlook Calendar
Outlook Calendar is a powerful scheduling tool that helps you manage your time efficiently. With features such as event reminders, shared calendars, and integration with your email, it enables seamless organization and collaboration. You can easily schedule meetings, set up recurring events, and even coordinate with team members across different time zones. Its user-friendly interface and robust functionality make Outlook Calendar an essential tool for both personal and professional time management.
Google Calendar
Google Calendar is a user-friendly tool that helps you manage your schedule efficiently. With features like event reminders, shared calendars, and integration with other Google services, it simplifies organizing personal and professional events. Easily create and share events, set up recurring appointments, and collaborate with others, making it essential for staying organized
Stripe
Stripe is a leading online payment processing platform designed to facilitate secure and efficient transactions for businesses of all sizes. With its robust API, Stripe enables seamless integration with websites and mobile apps, allowing companies to accept payments from customers worldwide. It supports a wide range of payment methods, including credit cards, digital wallets, and bank transfers, ensuring flexibility and convenience.
Credly
Credly is a leading digital credentialing platform that allows organizations to recognize and verify individuals' skills and achievements. By issuing digital badges, Credly enables professionals to showcase their qualifications and competencies online, making it easier for employers to identify and validate talent. The platform supports seamless integration with various learning management systems, providing a streamlined process for awarding and tracking credentials.
Salesforce
Salesforce is a leading customer relationship management (CRM) platform that provides a comprehensive suite of tools for managing sales, customer service, marketing, and more. It enables businesses to track customer interactions, streamline workflows, and analyze data to improve decision-making and drive growth. With its cloud-based architecture, Salesforce offers scalability and flexibility, allowing organizations to customize solutions to meet their specific needs.
Google Chromebook
Google Chromebook is a lightweight laptop designed to run on Chrome OS, an operating system by Google. It offers fast, secure, and simple computing with built-in virus protection and automatic updates. Chromebooks are optimized for web-based applications and integrate seamlessly with Google Workspace tools like Docs, Drive, and Meet, making them ideal for students, educators, and professionals who need a reliable and cost-effective device for online tasks.
Accredible
Accredible is a leading digital credentialing platform that allows organizations to issue, manage, and verify digital certificates and badges. It provides a secure and efficient way to recognize achievements, skills, and qualifications. Accredible's user-friendly interface and robust features enable educational institutions, professional organizations, and businesses to create and distribute verifiable digital credentials easily. With Accredible, recipients can showcase their accomplishments online, enhancing their professional profiles and increasing their visibility to employers and peers
Wix
Wix is a user-friendly website builder that lets you create professional websites with ease. It offers customizable templates, e-commerce capabilities, and SEO tools, making it simple to build and manage your online presence. With its drag-and-drop interface and integrated marketing solutions, anyone can create a dynamic and effective website, regardless of technical skill.
ROC-P
ROC-P (Remote Online Certification Proctoring) is a secure solution for administering online exams. It combines advanced technology with real-time monitoring to ensure exam integrity. ROC-P allows candidates to take exams from any location, providing flexibility and convenience while maintaining high certification standards. Its robust proctoring protocols prevent cheating, ensuring a fair and compliant testing process. This makes ROC-P ideal for organizations seeking to uphold rigorous certification requirements while accommodating remote test-takers.
Thinkific
Talview's proctoring solution seamlessly integrates with Thinkific, offering a secure and cost-effective way to conduct exams without compromising on integrity or candidate experience. Designed to prevent cheating while maintaining a stress-free and efficient testing environment, our remote proctoring solution is trusted to deliver exceptional results for both learners and organizations.
Lemon Squeezy
Lemon Squeezy is a specifically designed for digital creators and businesses aiming to sell digital products and subscriptions online. It offers a comprehensive suite of features tailored to the unique needs of creators. Users can easily upload and organize their digital offerings, whether e-books, software, or online courses, while integrated payment processing enables secure and flexible transactions for customers.
Brillium
Brillium is a platform that specializes in providing assessment and credentialing solutions, designed to help organizations create, manage, and deliver assessments effectively. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools and services suitable for educational institutions, professional certification bodies, and corporations. With Brillium, users can easily create custom assessments tailored to specific requirements, utilizing various question types and formats.
risr
risr is an innovative assessment platform that revolutionizes the way assessments are created, administered, and analyzed across diverse sectors, including education and professional training. This cutting-edge tool is designed to simplify the entire assessment process, empowering educators, trainers, and learners to engage with evaluations effortlessly.
Microsoft Forms
Microsoft Forms is a lightweight, easy-to-use tool for creating surveys, quizzes, assessments, and polls. It offers real-time response tracking, auto-generated charts, and integration with Microsoft 365 tools, making it ideal for quick data collection and feedback. Whether you're conducting a quiz, survey, assessments, or a registration form, Microsoft Forms provides a seamless experience across devices.
Google Forms
Google Forms is a widely used, intuitive tool for creating surveys, quizzes, and forms. It allows users to collect data, conduct assessments, surveys, and generate reports easily, all within the Google Workspace. With real-time collaboration and customization capabilities, Google Forms is ideal for educators, organizations, and certification providers who want quick, reliable data collection.
Totara LMS
Totara LMS is a powerful enterprise learning platform designed to support corporate training, compliance programs, and workforce development initiatives. Organizations worldwide use Totara learning solutions to deliver structured training, certifications, and high-stakes assessments at scale. With Talview’s AI Proctoring Solution, secure online proctoring is seamlessly enabled directly within Totara LMS, Protecting the integrity of Totara learning assessments without disrupting the candidate experience.
